items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of George Lewis by the interviewee (Don Albert). The mention is made by the interviewer referring to a third party ('He played with George Lewis').

ctx.x: He still plays the parade. Oh, he's fine.
He's a good musician. He played with George Lewis the last time I heard him up in Columbus, Bill.
He made a trip to Europe with Kidori, too, about four years ago.
